summary.work_completed: Completed Gate 8 frontend code review of PR #71 (NFR-REL-001 Auto-Save Crash Durability). Reviewed all 5 production modules: persistenceService.ts, crashRecoveryService.ts, persistenceStore.ts, useAutoSave.ts, ResumePrompt.tsx. Posted 8 inline review comments. Verdict: APPROVE WITH COMMENTS.

medium: Missing beforeunload handler in useAutoSave.ts — required for graceful close detection per LLD Section 6
Unsafe `as never` type cast in useAutoSave.ts — snapshot missing required fields (sessionId, timestamp, schemaVersion, cameraState, sceneMetadata)
low: Silent error swallowing in useAutoSave.ts — save errors not surfaced to UI or logged
PersistenceError and PersistenceErrorCode defined but unused in persistenceService.ts
positive: Correct orphaned session detection in crashRecoveryService.ts
Clean Zustand state machine in persistenceStore.ts
